description: The air is warm and still, holding the quiet dust of a thousand folded hours. Moths with wings like stained glass cluster on the brass gears, keeping the time that never rushes. A single paper lantern glows low, casting long, soft shadows that move as slowly as a sleeping breath.

objects.name: moth-wing hourglass
objects.seed: a small glass vessel filled with fine brass dust, where two moth wings rest on the sand to mark a pause in the day

objects.name: folded paper hour
objects.seed: a crisp square of cream paper tucked into a brass gear, holding a single written minute of rest for the village clock

phrase: an attic where the moths keep the hours
room_seed: a high attic room where soft-winged moths rest on shelves of brass gears, their dust forming gentle hours in the amber light
title: The Moth Attic
